list: We will hold our church Thanksgiving meal on Sunday, November 22, following the morning service. The church will provide the meat and sides, so please bring desserts.

The Christmas Card Drive for the Lottie Moon Christmas Offering begins next week. We need the cards by Wednesday, December 16; they can be given to Mike, Brian, or Butch. We ask for a $100 donation to the LMCO if you want to place a greeting on the screen. Please email image files (not screenshots) to greeting@manchesterbaptistchurch.org by December 1.
Our quarterly business meeting is Sunday, December 6.

fighterVerse.text: … My grace is sufficient for thee: for my strength is made perfect in weakness. Most gladly therefore will I rather glory in my infirmities, that the power of Christ may rest upon me.
